scientific_question: Does adding physically structured detector translation and dilation tangent directions to the frozen v20 effective-full lift span restore the five-trajectory development compatibility envelope, while same-capacity shuffled and single-generator controls fail?

scope.held_out_rule: for each fold, dual mean, dual PCA basis, and all tangent rows use only the other four trajectories
scope.parent_model_boundary: the frozen parent CNN was previously fit on all five trajectories; this experiment is not end-to-end cross-trajectory generalization
scope.truth_boundary: held-out exact lifts choose oracle row-span coefficients and are unavailable at deployment

frozen_representation.base: trajectory-balanced centered PCA of proposal dual innovations from four fit trajectories; all 199 effective directions are lifted offline through exact A-transpose
frozen_representation.translation: fixed centered horizontal and vertical detector derivatives, computed independently inside each native view
frozen_representation.dilation: x times horizontal derivative plus y times vertical derivative with coordinates linearly spaced from -1 to 1 in each native view
frozen_representation.offline_lift: every tangent dual row is transformed through exact A-transpose and normalised before evaluation
frozen_representation.coefficient_objective: held-out lift-L2 row-span oracle, used only to determine representation headroom
frozen_representation.online_claim: none; no observable coefficient predictor exists in v22

control_contract.base_identity: the base candidate must reproduce the independently validated v20 primary effective-full candidate within max absolute difference 1e-10
control_contract.shuffled_capacity: the shuffled arm uses the same tangent rows, per-row norms, row count, and effective rank as the physical arm, but a fixed per-view spatial permutation destroys detector locality
control_contract.single_generator_controls: translation-only and dilation-only test whether the joint result is a genuine combination rather than one generator alone
control_contract.same_solver: all arms use the same strict CGLS K1 refinement and the same Zero-CGLS K4 reference
control_contract.same_metrics: unchanged field, gradient, observation, joint match, harm, p50, p90, and worst compatibility contract

decision.pass: physical joint arm passes all-frame and skipped-frame compatibility on all five trajectories; base, shuffled, translation-only, and dilation-only each fail globally; physical and shuffled row count and effective rank match; base reproduces v20
decision.inconclusive: physical passes but a capacity or single-generator control also passes globally
decision.fail: physical joint arm fails any held-out trajectory
decision.invalid: v20 base identity, source/data binding, or physical/shuffled capacity matching fails

next_gate_if_pass: freeze and train an observation-only coefficient predictor inside the physical tangent span; the oracle result alone cannot open fresh, stopping-validation, or test trajectories
